note_text:
Nephrology clinic - new referral

CC: protein in urine on work physical.

HPI: 24 y/o M w/ burning pain in hands and feet since about age 9, comes in attacks lasting hrs-days, worse with hot weather, exercise, or when he gets a fever. Says he barely sweats, even playing basketball, and gets 'wiped out' in the heat. Intermittent crampy belly pain and loose stools after meals x yrs. Notes foamy urine x 6 mo. Ringing in both ears. Denies CP, vision changes, or fainting. Wears glasses for nearsightedness.

FHx: maternal uncle started dialysis at 42, died of a stroke at 50. Mother has 'kidney issues', no workup. No known consanguinity.

Exam: BP 142/88. Cluster of tiny dark-red raised spots around umbilicus and over the scrotum, nonblanching. Slit lamp: faint whorl-like opacities in both corneas. No swelling of legs. Neuro intact.
